recipe.truncation: tokenizer right truncation, retaining special tokens
recipe.search: exact cosine over all active children, without lexical pruning
recipe.lanes: unchanged original question and supplied full translation; top-K per lane then union
recipe.descriptive_cut_order: first K admitted children from the raw top-256; equivalent to raw top-K when resource_skipped=0
recipe.scope: complete prepared project corpus, including catalogued module documents

limitations: Candidate recall only, not admission or end-to-end delivery.
256 candidates applies per lane, so a translated question can union up to 512 children.
Lexical+semantic union uses additional candidates; it is not a fixed-total-budget hybrid.
Embedding input after 512 tokens is not read by the model.
Timing can be affected by concurrent work and is not a controlled model comparison.
